subject: springboot
question: In Spring Boot 3, which project replaces Spring Cloud Sleuth for distributed tracing?
options: Micrometer Tracing
OpenCensus Spring
Spring Cloud Zipkin Starter
Actuator Trace Endpoint
explanation: Sleuth's core moved into Micrometer Tracing, built on the Micrometer Observation API.

subject: springboot
question: An outer REQUIRED method catches a RuntimeException thrown by an inner REQUIRED method in another bean. What happens at commit?
options: The outer transaction commits normally
Only the inner method's changes are rolled back
UnexpectedRollbackException, since the shared transaction was marked rollback-only
The inner method is retried automatically
explanation: Both methods share one physical transaction, and the inner interceptor marked it rollback-only.

subject: springboot
question: Why does spring-boot-devtools not affect an app started with java -jar from a packaged jar?
options: Devtools turns itself off when the app runs as a fully packaged application
Maven deletes devtools during packaging
Devtools needs the prod profile
java -jar ignores every optional dependency
explanation: Devtools treats a packaged launch as production and disables itself; repackage also excludes it by default.

subject: springboot
question: What happens if spring.profiles.active is set inside application-dev.properties?
options: dev activates the listed profiles recursively
Startup fails, because it is not allowed in profile-specific documents
It replaces the profiles from the command line
The value is silently ignored
explanation: Since Boot 2.4, using spring.profiles.active in a profile-specific document raises an InvalidConfigDataPropertyException.

subject: springboot
question: How does a servlet Filter differ from a Spring MVC HandlerInterceptor?
options: A Filter runs only after the response is committed
A Filter runs in the servlet container before DispatcherServlet, while an interceptor runs around the chosen handler
An interceptor can modify requests before any Filter runs
They are identical, just registered differently
explanation: Interceptors have access to the resolved handler method; filters work at the raw servlet level.

subject: springboot
question: What is the default of management.endpoint.health.show-details?
options: always
when-authorized
never
on-error
explanation: By default only the aggregate status is shown, without component details.

subject: springboot
question: In Spring Framework 6, does a request to /users/ match a handler mapped to /users by default?
options: No, trailing slash matching is disabled by default
Only for GET requests
Only when the handler uses @RestController
Yes, trailing slashes are always ignored
explanation: Spring 6 deprecated trailing slash matching and turned it off by default.

subject: springboot
question: What does spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true do for a Spring MVC app on Java 21?
options: The embedded server handles requests on virtual threads
It switches the app to reactive WebFlux
It enables a fixed pool of 200 platform threads
It makes all controller methods asynchronous futures
explanation: Since Boot 3.2 this property configures Tomcat or Jetty and task executors to use virtual threads.

subject: springboot
question: In @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false), what happens when beanA() calls beanB() directly?
options: The container's singleton beanB is returned via CGLIB
Startup fails because inter-bean calls are forbidden
A new instance is created by a plain Java call, not the container's singleton
beanB becomes prototype-scoped automatically
explanation: Without CGLIB proxying, @Bean methods are ordinary methods, so inter-bean calls bypass the container.

subject: springboot
question: Which JPA association is fetched EAGER by default?
options: @OneToMany
@ElementCollection
@ManyToMany
@ManyToOne
explanation: To-one associations default to EAGER, while to-many associations default to LAZY.
